name: Flat-Plane
description: Bold silhouettes and minimal depth variation. Fast to carve, visually clear from a distance.
carving_traits: Great for signage or woodcut emulation
Works well with fewer Z-steps or large bits
machinability_prompt: Produce a grayscale heightmap with minimal depth changes. Use clean shape edges with stepped or flat Z-values. Background must be solid black. Avoid any photoreal shading or gradients.
